text:
Statements Q-1, Q-2, Q-3
WISCONSIN DEPARTMENT OF NATURAL RESOURCES
BUREAU OF ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT
A separate Air Quality Report was submitted for their review and comment on October 23, 1975. This report was written and supplemented in response to their detailed comments on the air quality section of the Draft EIS.
Further revisions were undertaken after Wisconsin Administrative Code NR154, "Indirect Source Rules" became effective on July 1, 1975. A summary of the air quality assessment for the Airport Spur is contained in Section IV.
Coordination meetings were held to respond to these DNR comments and satisfactorily resolve the issues. A listing of those meetings are shown on pages 259 and 260.
The Final EIS has been expanded to reflect the comments contained in the DNR's letter of review and comment, Statements Q-1 and Q-2.
The attached DNR's statement, Q-3 constitutes DNR's approval of the Air Quality Report and Notice of Intent. This letter states approval of construction, pursuant to Wisconsin Administration Code NR 154.05 and Mr. Becker's endorsement of the Notice of Intent on page 135 of this report completes their approvals.
